body:
Here’s the question:

 I recently watched Brian’s McLaren’s youtube presentation for the Anderson University Chapel Convocation on October 23, 2008. http://video.google.com/videoplay?docid=5745330950759630992&hl=en

I would like to purchase a copy of that presentation. If that is possible, please tell me how to go about it.

 Reply after the jump.

First, thanks – I imagine some other people would benefit from knowing this presentation is available. As for purchasing it – I think you could contact Anderson University chapel and see if they can make it available. It looks like you can download it for free directly from video.google.com too.

This talk is based on a book I wrote called More Ready Than You Realize if you’d like to get the full story and have the emails, which are printed in the book in a fuller form.
